beats.text: As a baby, Hanuman thought the rising sun was a ripe fruit, and leapt into the sky to eat it.
Indra struck him with his thunderbolt, and he fell. The gods blessed him with great powers.
But as a child, a curse from the sages had made Hanuman forget his own strength, until someone reminded him.
Jambavan spoke of his birth, his speed and his courage. 'You are the son of the wind. Rise, Hanuman. The whole world waits for you.'
Slowly, Hanuman remembered. His body began to glow.
He grew vast as a mountain and stood on Mount Mahendra. The earth trembled. Rocks cracked. Animals ran from their caves.
He bowed to the sun, to Indra, to the wind, and to Rama.
'Jai Shri Ram!' he roared, and leapt toward Lanka. The mountain sank under the force, and trees flew after him into the sky.
